model:
rachana: 1
sutra: inflation-curve
version: 1
description: 
match: { kind: inflation-curve, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: "Market data · Inflation curve", id: "$.CURVE_ID" }
strip:
  - { label: "Index", bind: "$.INDEX" }
  - { label: "5Y breakeven", bind: "$.BE_5Y", fmt: "pct2", emphasis: true }
  - { label: "10Y breakeven", bind: "$.BE_10Y", fmt: "pct2" }
panels:
  - id: curve
    kind: line
    title: "ZC breakevens (%)"
    key: "F2"
    phone: { tier: "glance", from: "fragment" }
    rows: "$.POINTS"
    x: "TENOR"
    y: "BREAKEVEN"
    fmt: "price2"
  - id: seasonality
    kind: hbar
    title: "Seasonality"
    area: right
    phone: { tier: "glance", from: "fragment", rows: 5 }
    rows: "$.SEASONALITY"
    label: "MONTH"
    value: "FACTOR"
    fmt: "price2"
  - id: built
    kind: provenance
    title: "How this view was built"
    phone: { tier: "more", from: "fragment" }
  - id: refs
    kind: links
    title: "Linked entities"
    code: "REFS"
    area: right
    phone: { tier: "more", from: "fragment" }
keys: { F7: "link($.INFLATION_INDEX, 'inflation-index')", F8: "impact", F9: "raw" }
